name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 9 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-08-21, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.67 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
